compute_kid: compute the Kernel Inception Distance between real and generated image features using polynomial kernel MMD
run_compute_kid: run compute_kid with opts, max_real samples, num_gen samples, num_subsets, and max_subset_size parameters
test_compute_kid: test compute_kid by passing real and generated feature stats through the polynomial kernel computation
review_compute_kid: review compute_kid to understand how it uses the Inception v3 feature extractor and cubic polynomial kernel
summarize_compute_kid: summarize compute_kid which calculates KID score by comparing real dataset features against generator features
